description: Lookalike-domain alerts, monthly: buy it in one x402 payment. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (POST /buy/brandwatch-monthly, $99 in one payment), with the response schema and an example; POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. A free check first: POST the same body to /buy/brandwatch-monthly/check (email required). One month; for a year use buy_brandwatch. Payable with x402 or MPP.
